components.name: Embedded Linux Base Platform
components.description: Embedded-Linux distribution base layer. Includes the kernel, bootloader, and root filesystem.

components.name: nginx
components.description: Web server and reverse proxy serving the supervisory UI and REST API.

components.name: open62541 OPC UA Stack
components.description: Device-embedded OPC UA server implementation. Provides the tag address space and secure channels.

components.name: BusyBox
components.description: Collection of core embedded-Linux utilities. Provides boot scripts and diagnostic shell commands.

components.name: GoAhead Embedded Web Server
components.description: Small web server that serves the configuration web UI of embedded devices.

components.name: Net-SNMP
components.description: SNMP agent that lets a network management system poll device status.

components.name: Expat
components.description: Streaming XML parser. Used to process device-description files and project configurations.

components.name: wpa_supplicant
components.description: Supplicant performing WPA2/WPA3 authentication and key exchange for the wireless backhaul link.

components.name: Eclipse Mosquitto
components.description: Edge-layer MQTT broker. Publishes field data to upper systems.

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Embedded database engine for alarm history, trend buffers, and local configuration storage.

components.name: Dropbear SSH
components.description: Lightweight SSH server. Provides field engineers a remote diagnostic shell access path.

components.name: CODESYS Control Runtime System
components.description: Control runtime that executes IEC 61131-3 programs. Includes online change and a communication server.

components.name: ECU-1251 Trend Buffer Service
components.description: Service that accumulates short-term trend data in a circular buffer and forwards it to the upstream historian server.

components.name: ECU-1251 Diagnostics and Event Logger
components.description: Module that collects and retains device status events, diagnostic codes, and audit logs.

components.name: ECU-1251 Redundancy Management Module
components.description: Module that manages state synchronization between the redundant pair and seamless failover.

components.name: ECU-1251 Firmware Update Agent
components.description: Update agent that performs firmware-image reception, verification, and activation, including signature verification.

components.name: ECU-1251 Time Synchronization Service
components.description: Service that maintains NTP/PTP-based time synchronization and event-timestamp consistency.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP server/client functionality. Handles register and coil access requests.

components.name: MQTT Client Stack
components.description: MQTT client stack for edge data publishing.

components.name: OPC UA Server Stack
components.description: Server stack providing the OPC UA address space, subscriptions, and secure channels.

components.name: DNP3 Outstation Stack
components.description: DNP3 outstation implementation. Handles event-class polling and unsolicited responses.
